findings.text: The oracle computes expected from wedge_oracle._support_vertices(wedges, slot), the carrier's own emitted wedge polygons, so the asserted relative_error at line 514 cannot fail on a mislabelled, mis-paired or mis-ordered wedge; the labelling claim rests on the synthetic symmetric case in tests/test_xpoint_cell_wedge_clip.py, and an independent region measure is what confirms the production case here.

The branch-expansion block runs under a static curve-evaluator test and is then discarded by jnp.where(saddle, expanded, branch_polygon) at lines 1332 and 1335 for every cell; no production caller supplies both a spline tracer and a saddle vertex (forward_operator.py:2956 passes curve_evaluator without saddle_vertex), so on the spline route the expansion is computed and dropped for every cell while the saddle cell is actually handled by _expand_spline_saddle_wedges at lines 1822-1861.

justifications.durability: All five commits carry a body stating what changed and why, none carries an AI attribution trailer, and a scan of every added line found no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in symbols or comments; the evidence section and the plan landing comment carry the same numbers as the logs, and the figure is committed beside the code it illustrates. The point is held back only because the landing record presents the self-referential oracle numbers as the physics check without naming the geometric assumption they rest on.
justifications.evidence: The gate reproduces first-hand in one all_debug job through the shared interpreter (13 passed in 52.92 s, EXIT=0) with the node's exact numbers: core-current relative errors 1.0592653460397069e-13 at 110 cells, 3.9298727478012714e-13 at 300, 7.582948143696231e-14 at 500, with private-flux current 0.0 and common-SOL current [0.0, 0.0], and the figure reads as four wedge loops, line contours, wall polyline and both null vocabularies. The deduction is that the oracle's expected value is taken from the carrier's own emitted polygons, so the reported 1e-13 measures the quadrature and profile path against the carrier geometry rather than the geometry against the physics; a mislabelled or mis-paired wedge would not move it. This review supplied the missing independent instrument: the analytic confined-side area inside the X-point cell measures 3.8004855501913453e-3 m2 on a 2000x2000 grid while the carrier core plus private wedges measure 3.8029e-3 m2 (6.4e-5 core sliver plus 3.7387e-3 private), agreeing to 0.06 percent, and the core lobe centroid lies within about 3 degrees of the direction from the saddle to the magnetic axis.
justifications.fit: The new route belongs in separatrix_clip.py beside the straight route and follows the module's fixed-capacity idiom, but the first commit left a second implementation of the same branch expansion inside _traced_clip, guarded only by a static curve-evaluator test, whose result is discarded for every cell on the production spline route because no caller supplies a saddle vertex together with a curve evaluator; it costs roughly 256 traced level-set samples per cell per call and duplicates _expand_spline_saddle_wedges.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The declared goal is met as written: the spline-chain clip admits the supplied saddle vertex (pre-fix reproduction.log fails at tests/test_xpoint_cell_wedge_clip.py:41 with support.saddle false, post-fix passes), every spline root per cell edge is retained (test_spline_chain_retains_two_roots_on_one_edge, test_two_roots_on_one_edge_still_emit_four_wedges), the traced support is split by branch into four wedges inside the mesh-derived capacity with exact-zero padding, and the production companion wiring plus the H200 certificate rows are named unfinished rather than claimed.
justifications.scope_discipline: All five commits touch only declared write paths under nova/equilibrium/separatrix_clip.py, tests/test_xpoint_cell_wedge_clip.py, tests/test_forward_census.py, docs/figures/cut-cell-current-attribution/xpoint-cell, docs/plans/cut-cell-current-attribution.html and docs/evidence/archive/cut-cell-current-attribution-landed.html; no file outside the fence was written, no plan or state file was mutated outside the declared paths, and tests/test_separatrix_clip.py was declared but left untouched.
